lines.text: One who scatters advances against Nineveh, and the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob.
The warriors are dressed in scarlet, and the chariots dash through the streets like torches and lightning.
The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses, and it is decreed that the city be exiled.
Nineveh is like a pool that is freezing over, and the plunderers take the silver and the gold.
The LORD of Hosts declares He will reduce her chariots to cinders, and the voices of her prophets will no longer be heard.
